title: Stress Management
description: Comprehensive stress reduction plan with relaxation techniques, time management, and self-care practices

goals.title: Improve Work-Life Balance
goals.description: Create healthy boundaries between work and rest

goals.title: Build Resilience
goals.description: Develop ability to handle stress better

tasks.title: Identify Stressors
tasks.description: List main sources of stress in your life

tasks.title: Prioritize Tasks
tasks.description: Create a priority system for responsibilities

tasks.title: Learn Relaxation
tasks.description: Practice deep breathing and muscle relaxation

tasks.title: Schedule Self-Care
tasks.description: Block time for activities you enjoy

warnings: Stress management is a journey, not a destination
Some stress is normal and healthy
Don't be too hard on yourself
Seek professional help if stress becomes unmanageable
fallback_message: I found a stress management template! This plan will help you reduce stress and find better balance.
